title: Tego reason file v1 (last-refusal.json)
description: The reason file a run's ledger writer rewrites after refusals (spec/reason/REASON-CHANNEL.md section 2, ADR 0061). The top level is the latest refusal; recent is the newest refusals, oldest first, the latest last. At most 65536 bytes. pkg/spec/reason mirrors this file; TestReasonFileSchemaMatchesGo keeps their keys and required keys equal. Keys a later v1 adds are ignored by older readers.

v.description: The reason file's own version; not a record minor.

seq.description: The latest refused line's ledger seq; it only grows across rewrites.

ts.description: The latest refused line's ts, RFC 3339 with nanoseconds, UTC.

target.description: A string the agent chose; one longer than 4096 bytes is cut and ends with its length in bytes.

reason.description: A code of the closed set (REASON-CHANNEL.md).

text.description: One plain sentence for the latest refusal (pkg/spec/reason Text).

refusals.description: How many refused lines the run's ledger had written; a reader keeps it as its cursor.
